description: Electric Generation By Fuel Type, GWh: Beginning 1960 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. New York Electric Generation By Fuel Type, GWh dataset provides data on total electricity requirements and in-state generation for New York State in giga-watt hours. Sources of electricity include coal, natural gas, petroleum products, hydro, nuclear, waste, landfill gas, wood, wind, solar, and net imports of electricity. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are electricity, nyserda patterns and trends, renewable, electric generation, p&t. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority. The portal shows 2024-07-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
